tools.name: upload_knowledge_text
tools.description: Add a piece of text — an FAQ, policy, guide, article or notes — to a knowledge source as a plain-text document. Uploading again with the same id replaces that document's text. For products (price, stock, attributes, variants) use upload_knowledge_docs. Requires your account API key and the source to

tools.name: create_persona
tools.description: Start building a new PersonAIzer persona from a website URL — reads the site's brand facts, makes the brand, synthesizes the persona's identity and avatar, and (by default) crawls the site into the brand's knowledge; the persona and the crawl run in parallel. Asynchronous (~1 minute for the persona)

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send a message to a PersonAIzer persona and get its reply, including any knowledge-base cards it surfaces. Requires your account API key and the persona_id to speak as.

tools.name: upload_knowledge_docs
tools.description: Upsert up to 100 PRODUCTS (including services and unpriced catalog entries) into a knowledge source. For plain text (FAQs, policies, guides, articles, notes) use upload_knowledge_text instead. Requires your account API key; the source must exist (POST /v1/knowledge/sources).

tools.name: check_persona_status
tools.description: Poll the status of a persona build started by create_persona. Requires an account-level API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_persona, chat · Private data: upload_knowledge_text, create_persona, chat, upload_knowledge_docs, check_persona_status · Public sink: upload_knowledge_text, chat, upload_knowledge_docs · Destructive: create_persona.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_persona, chat · Private data: upload_knowledge_text, create_persona, chat, upload_knowledge_docs, check_persona_status · Public sink: upload_knowledge_text, chat, upload_knowledge_docs · Destructive: create_persona

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_knowledge" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_persona" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
